notes: P6-QA (found live, 2026-08-11): a pre-quantized (int4) redistribution of black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B, published directly on HF -- 4.61GB of already-4-bit weight files (verified via HfApi), versus the base manifest's ~23.7GB full-precision-only repo, which mflux would load entirely into memory before quantizing (the OOM this manifest exists to route around: mflux's own load path is `_load_weights` (full precision) then `_apply_and_quantize`, so an already-quantized source is what actually keeps peak memory down, not a lower `quantize=` argument against the full-precision repo). Same `variant`/`latent_space` as the base FLUX.2 Klein manifest (mechanically the same Flux2Klein class/architecture) -- disambiguated at load time by `model_path=` (the manifest's own `id`), not a new variant tag. Verified live: real end-to-end generation, ~11s for 4 steps, no OOM, on a 19.3GB machine.
